arguments.name: index
arguments.text: One position, counting from 1, or one element name.

arguments.name: exact
arguments.text: When true, a character index must match the whole name.

origin.details: Unlike [, this returns the element itself. An index past the end is an error. A name that is absent returns a missing result rather than a partial match, unless exact is false.
